name: quetrex-base
description: Quetrex Base — Claude Code base configuration for development teams. Agents, skills, and commands for a complete AI-powered development pipeline.

scripts.check:sh: for f in .claude/hooks/*.sh .claude/lib/*.sh .claude/*.sh .claude/skills/*/*.sh .claude/skills/*/scripts/*.sh test/*.sh; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.check:json: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const files=['package.json','.claude/settings.json','.claude/templates/verify.json','.quetrex/verify.json','.claude-plugin/plugin.json','hooks/hooks.json'];for(const f of files){JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'))}console.log('ok - '+files.length+' JSON files parse')"
